I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

The screen is 1280px wide and sits inside `#component`. It has a slim Harbor top bar, then the "Audit log" heading with the "Date range" select set to "Last 7 days". Below that is a card with the eight events, each showing time, person and action.

I followed `DESIGN.md`: only its colors, type sizes, spacing and radii, with motion on its easing curve and a reduced-motion override.

- **Fonts:** the files don't include Unbounded or Archivo, and the brief said to use no other assets. The CSS lists them first and falls back to system fonts, so the headline will look different unless those fonts are installed locally.
- **Extra elements:** I added a few things that weren't in your content list: the top-bar navigation, the Time / Person / Action column labels, and initials avatars. Delete them if you want only the exact content.
